Target 74x100 logical pixels, portrait canvas, simple coarse connected pixel clusters in 24-32 muted colors, NO antialiasing, no painterly softness, no gradients, no dithering, no numerous hair lines.
Character: woman about 36, a relocated trial grower, firmly self-possessed and cautious but quietly questioning. Latest canonical appearance: comparatively PALE LIGHT SKIN. Use neutral light beige skin with desaturated dusty rosy-brown shadow planes. Do not use orange, golden, peach-tan or glowing warm skin. She is neither a teenager nor an old woman. Recognizable short dark-brown almost-black bob, plain low-saturation rust-red kerchief tied at rear, dark navy work dress and tiny brown apron strap and cream neck edge. Do not make a shoulder bust. No large blank area above the head. All hair, scarf, knot, tails, ears and collar have their own true transparent clearance. Keep every visible pixel between 5%-95% canvas width, and between 3%-97% canvas height, so no object touches or is cut by any canvas edge. Tails should be compact and folded downward to fit, without making face small. Transparent RGBA background, no backdrop or text. This should look like the face-centered source pixel portraits, with broad simple shapes that read crisply at original 74x100 size.
